title: MermaidFrontmatter
description: The YAML metadata block at the start of a Mermaid document. This model holds only the content between the '---' fences; the serializer adds the fences. Every key is optional. Closed value sets are enforced; open maps stay permissive so valid, undocumented keys are not rejected.

displayMode.description: The display mode. The source documents 'compact' for the gantt diagram. Left open because the full value set is not fixed by the source page.

config.title: MermaidConfig
config.description: Reconfiguration applied before the render. Known universal keys are listed below. This map is open: additional keys hold either configuration values from the manual's Configuration section or a per-type block keyed by the diagram type name (for example 'gantt: { useWidth: 400, compact: true }').

theme.description: The color scheme. Known values: 'default', 'forest', 'neutral', 'dark', 'base'. The source names a 'redux-color' theme family but does not list its members, so this value is left open.

layout.description: The layout algorithm. 'elk' is the default.

useGradient.description: Paint node strokes with a gradient. The 'base' theme sets this on by default.

elk.title: ElkLayoutOptions
elk.description: Extra options for the 'elk' layout. The keys below are the ones the source documents; the map stays permissive because the ELK layout accepts more options upstream.

nodePlacementStrategy.description: The node placement strategy. 'BRANDES_KOEPF' is the default.
